# gitmoap_group_issue_blueprints (Data Source)

List a group's available custom types. Returns the custom types the group defines, ordered by id. With `include=inherited` it adds those its parent groups define, nearest group first, and a type defined nearer the group hides one with the same id further up; each type says whether it is inherited. Anyone who can see the group's work items may list them — on a public group, without signing in.

The token needs `issue_blueprint:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_issue_blueprints" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Optional

- `include` (String) Set to `inherited` to include ancestor-group blueprints

### Read-Only

- `group_issue_blueprints` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints))

<a id="nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_issue_blueprints`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Hidden from the type picker; items already filed keep their `type_profile`.
- `base_type` (String) The kind of work item. The type decides where an item may live (a group or a repository), which
types it may have as children, and which fields it accepts.
- `blueprint_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints--created_by))
- `description` (String)
- `facets` (Attributes List) The blueprint's facets, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints--facets))
- `inherited` (Boolean) `true` when the blueprint is defined on an ancestor group rather than on the queried scope.
- `name` (String) The custom type's display name, such as "API Feature".
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `version` (Number) The blueprint's revision, incremented on every change. An update must send the version it
read, and is refused with a `409` if the blueprint changed since.

<a id="nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints--created_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_issue_blueprints.created_by`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.


<a id="nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints--facets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_issue_blueprints.facets`

Read-Only:

- `binding` (Attributes) How the criterion a facet adds is bound: `manual` (the default), or `bound` to evidence the
platform checks. A blueprint whose base type lives only in a group, such as `epic`, may use only
`manual`.

`mode` says which applies: `manual`; `bound`, with `binding`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints--facets--binding))
- `category` (String)
- `hint` (String) The starter criterion's text. When absent the criterion is titled by the facet `label`.
- `key` (String)
- `label` (String) The facet's display name, such as "Observability".
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the facet's criterion must be satisfied before the work item can be closed or
verified. Defaults to `true`.

<a id="nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints--facets--binding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_issue_blueprints.facets.binding`

Read-Only:

- `criterion` (Attributes) What a criterion is bound to — the condition the platform checks on its behalf. A criterion with
no binding is a manual checkbox.

`kind` says which applies: `test`, with `suite`, `test_id`; `metric`, with `name`, `op`, `threshold`, `unit`; `coverage`, with `min_pct`, `path_glob`; `node`, with `node_id`; `scorecard_check`, with `check_key`, `scorecard_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints--facets--binding--criterion))
- `mode` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--group_issue_blueprints--facets--binding--criterion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_issue_blueprints.facets.binding.criterion`

Read-Only:

- `check_key` (String)
- `kind` (String)
- `min_pct` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `node_id` (String)
- `op` (String) How a measurement is compared against its threshold.
- `path_glob` (String)
- `scorecard_id` (String)
- `suite` (String)
- `test_id` (String)
- `threshold` (Number)
- `unit` (String)
